title: Exploring cardiac remodeling through atrial fibrillation burden monitoring using a 72-hour wearable ECG device and machine learning methods

contributions.purpose: 用 ML 从正常窦性节律(NSR)区分有无 AF 及不同 AF 负荷
contributions.mechanism: S-Patch 72h 可穿戴 ECG,夜间(0-6 时)HR<70 的 10 秒段,LGBM 二分类,82 特征(形态 45+统计 23+小波 14)
contributions.evaluation: 随 AF 负荷升高判别力单调上升;极端组(90-99%)AUC 0.9858(敏感 93.69%/特异 94.96%)
contributions.source_quote: model performance varied significantly across AF burden groups, with meaningful discrimination observed from AF burden levels of 70% and above

contributions.purpose: 支持 AF 负荷越高、结构重塑越显著的假设
contributions.evaluation: 低负荷组(10-20%)AUC 仅 0.4651(劣于随机);moderate 0.5777→high 0.6790→very high 0.8408→extreme 0.9858
contributions.source_quote: These findings highlight the trend of increasing accuracy with higher AF burden levels, supporting the hypothesis of significant cardiac remodeling associated with higher AF burden

notes: 真实临床研究(reject)。真实单中心数据:Wonju Severance 医院 1,673 名连续患者,S-Patch 设备,回顾性。无编号贡献列表,由 abstract/conclusion 归纳 2 条。负结果/trade-off:低 AF 负荷组(10-20%)AUC 0.4651 低于随机,判别失败(论文诚实报告并从 ROC 图中略去)。数据质量隐忧但非造假:高负荷分组样本极小(very high n=13、high n=29),AUC 0.9858 可能过拟合;类别严重不均衡(控制组 76.6%)。特征数自洽(45+23+14=82)。AI 披露:核心分析与临床结论 human-generated。四元组适配良好,数据无红旗。
